plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.slopes: integer 0..90; non-steep <= maximum; unselected navigation requires 55/55 and false flags

offmesh_connections.position: mandatory immediately after non-steep-slope; connection records precede all db2 records
offmesh_connections.float_encoding: exactly eight lowercase hexadecimal digits for the IEEE754 f32 u32 bit pattern; no prefix, decimal float or uppercase alias
offmesh_connections.integer_encoding: canonical unsigned decimal; no sign or leading zero except zero itself
offmesh_connections.endpoints: all six f32 values finite; signed zero retained by bits
offmesh_connections.radius: finite f32 strictly greater than zero
offmesh_connections.order: preserve input order and duplicates; no sorting or deduplication
offmesh_connections.representation: Plan.offmesh: Option<Vec<OffMeshConnection>>; None preserves v1-v5; Some including an empty vector selects v6
offmesh_connections.selection: global source records filter by map_id only in original input order; tile projection separately selects exact map/row/column
offmesh_connections.all_records_validated: every inline record validates even when its map or tile is unselected

schema_catalog.schema_catalog_line: forbidden; v6 fixes this catalog implicitly

collision_storage.scratch_policy: existing v3 leased-disk policy; extract/resume require --scratch only for explicit leased storage; inspect/verify require none

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability, encryption-key discovery or a complete archive snapshot; every read still requires complete content MD5
identities.offmesh: The complete canonical plan SHA-256 binds all source bits, record order, duplicates and the explicit empty v6 header to inspect/extract/resume/verify context; changing any of these changes plan identity.
identities.keys: Only the selected decryption capability enters plan identity. Key values, names, counts, hashes and paths remain excluded from CLI JSON, plans and package context; supplied key availability is not logical source identity.

resume: explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; complete output refuses writes; v6 sources, including signed-zero bits, order and duplicates, are part of the exact canonical plan identity; no hidden offmesh file is reread
empty_world: Complete empty Map direct rows admit zero navigation artifacts for All only when the v6 inline connection list is empty; any nonempty list fails with product_offmesh_empty_map before navigation completion.

verification.db2: complete bounded catalog decoding; exact selected name set
verification.gt: all 20 exact names; 14 numeric, six raw-only
verification.cameras: exact discovered raw file set from selected complete CinematicCamera; no M2 parsing
verification.maps: canonical names, selected map/tile scope, MAPS10/build and tilelist framing
verification.vmaps: VMAP_4.E intrinsic dtree/VMO/tree/tile/index framing and per-tree ordinal bounds
verification.mmaps: canonical selected names, MMAP16/Detour7 framing; every global MMap source list must equal the exact plan subset for that map by all f32 bits, integer fields, order and multiplicity
not_claimed: original C++ byte parity for newly produced worlds

offmesh.comparison: OffMeshConnection::from_source reconstructs all f32 u32 bits; compare exact iterators after plan map_id filtering, including duplicates and order
offmesh.legacy: v1-v5 retain empty-only globals and product_offmesh_unsupported
offmesh.scope: global source identity and intrinsic framing only; no proof that every source becomes a traversable Detour edge or that all selected geometry exists

failure: stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no hidden available-prefix, native, network or missing-file fallback
scope: Explicit bounded inline offmesh sources for the legacy pinned-metadata-v1 navigation product; no catalog v4/v5 extension or real-route acceptance.

pipeline.sources: convert validated bit-preserving plan records into offmesh::Source and pass them explicitly to navigation execution; no implicit file, native or network source
pipeline.publication: existing common Run transaction, receipts, component seals and final manifest; no available-prefix completion

memory_and_work.navigation_limits: existing navigation inventory/pipeline/offmesh limits and downward-only budgets unchanged
memory_and_work.scope: bounded logical capacities/work counters; not allocator RSS or all CPU work

provided_keys.input: explicit regular file, final symlink and special file rejected; read once with metadata identity and extra-byte EOF check
provided_keys.record_format: forever-tact-keys TAB 1 LF; sorted unique lowercase hex16 u64 name TAB hex32 key LF
provided_keys.cipher: Salsa20/20 with 16-byte keys, nonce4/8 padded to8, frame-index little-endian XOR, initial block counter zero
provided_keys.frames: one E wrapper around N or strict Z only; mandatory complete content MD5 and encoded frame MD5 where framed
provided_keys.source_protection: canonical key-file source included in protected roots before output writes
provided_keys.required_when: decryption is provided-salsa20-v1; disabled mode forbids --keys

failure_envelope: forever-product-v6 after valid plan admission; generic CLI/plan failures before admission retain forever-product-v1; all errors path-free

validation.synthetic_cli_acceptance: separate retained QA evidence; not established by these static checks
